def at_world {W : Type u} [BethFrame W] (w : W) (tm : Tm) : Prop :=
  match tm with
  | var v => val w v
  | Tm.and p q => at_world w p ∧ at_world w q
  | Tm.or p q =>
      ∃ (S : Sieve w), covers w S ∧ (∀ w' ∈ S, at_world w' p ∨ at_world w' q)
  | imp p q => ∀ (w' : W), w ≤ w' → at_world w' p → at_world w' q
  | tt => True
  | ff => False
